meta.title: Wrong Path
meta.description: We haven't changed, we've just steadily drifted apart.

units.rawText: One month before the isolation wall was erected, on one of the Cyclopes Sector's lookout towers.
units.displayText: One month before the isolation wall was erected, on one of the Cyclopes Sector's lookout towers.

spans.text: One month before the isolation wall was erected, on one of the Cyclopes Sector's lookout towers.

units.rawText: Under the simulated sunny sky, Olivia gazes into the distance absent-mindedly.
units.displayText: Under the simulated sunny sky, Olivia gazes into the distance absent-mindedly.

spans.text: Under the simulated sunny sky, Olivia gazes into the distance absent-mindedly.

units.rawText: You seem to be more and more into staring at nothing in particular in the distance nowadays.
units.displayText: You seem to be more and more into staring at nothing in particular in the distance nowadays.

spans.text: You seem to be more and more into staring at nothing in particular in the distance nowadays.

units.rawText: Anything troubling you with the Monitor Agents?
units.displayText: Anything troubling you with the Monitor Agents?

spans.text: Anything troubling you with the Monitor Agents?

units.rawText: Ah, why are you here at this time?
units.displayText: Ah, why are you here at this time?

spans.text: Ah, why are you here at this time?

units.rawText: A Monitor Agent told me to come for our regularly scheduled meeting. Why do you look like you have no idea what's going on?
units.displayText: A Monitor Agent told me to come for our regularly scheduled meeting. Why do you look like you have no idea what's going on?

spans.text: A Monitor Agent told me to come for our regularly scheduled meeting. Why do you look like you have no idea what's going on?

units.rawText: Is it time already?
units.displayText: Is it time already?

spans.text: Is it time already?

units.rawText: Sorry. I've been updating the system of the Monitor Agents, must've taken up too much of my internal memory.
units.displayText: Sorry. I've been updating the system of the Monitor Agents, must've taken up too much of my internal memory.

spans.text: Sorry. I've been updating the system of the Monitor Agents, must've taken up too much of my internal memory.

units.rawText: Updating? Why are you suddenly thinking about updates?
units.displayText: Updating? Why are you suddenly thinking about updates?

spans.text: Updating? Why are you suddenly thinking about updates?

units.rawText: Something wrong with the system recently? Let me have a look.
units.displayText: Something wrong with the system recently? Let me have a look.

spans.text: Something wrong with the system recently? Let me have a look.

units.rawText: Tasha takes a step towards Olivia.
units.displayText: Tasha takes a step towards Olivia.

spans.text: Tasha takes a step towards Olivia.

units.rawText: Olivia steps back subconsciously, surprised.
units.displayText: Olivia steps back subconsciously, surprised.

spans.text: Olivia steps back subconsciously, surprised.

units.rawText: Tasha retracted her hand.
units.displayText: Tasha retracted her hand.

spans.text: Tasha retracted her hand.

units.rawText: You are starting to fear the Combat-type Agents, aren't you?
units.displayText: You are starting to fear the Combat-type Agents, aren't you?

spans.text: You are starting to fear the Combat-type Agents, aren't you?

units.rawText: That's not it, Tasha... It's just that my response program isn't readjusted properly, and made a decision too quickly.
units.displayText: That's not it, Tasha... It's just that my response program isn't readjusted properly, and made a decision too quickly.

spans.text: That's not it, Tasha... It's just that my response program isn't readjusted properly, and made a decision too quickly.

units.rawText: ...It's alright. I understand. Monitor-types must ensure their safety first to tend to their duties properly, after all.
units.displayText: ...It's alright. I understand. Monitor-types must ensure their safety first to tend to their duties properly, after all.

spans.text: ...It's alright. I understand. Monitor-types must ensure their safety first to tend to their duties properly, after all.

units.rawText: And when you're on the job, a response program that's running fast will be without a doubt beneficial.
units.displayText: And when you're on the job, a response program that's running fast will be without a doubt beneficial.

spans.text: And when you're on the job, a response program that's running fast will be without a doubt beneficial.

units.rawText: Don't say such things. That's not what I meant. We should be cooperating seamlessly with each other, not on guard.
units.displayText: Don't say such things. That's not what I meant. We should be cooperating seamlessly with each other, not on guard.

spans.text: Don't say such things. That's not what I meant. We should be cooperating seamlessly with each other, not on guard.

units.rawText: That won't happen again. Come a bit closer, Tasha.
units.displayText: That won't happen again. Come a bit closer, Tasha.

spans.text: That won't happen again. Come a bit closer, Tasha.

units.rawText: Tasha does not move. Olivia gingerly takes two steps closer, standing shoulder to shoulder with her.
units.displayText: Tasha does not move. Olivia gingerly takes two steps closer, standing shoulder to shoulder with her.

spans.text: Tasha does not move. Olivia gingerly takes two steps closer, standing shoulder to shoulder with her.

units.rawText: A few seconds later, the tension leaves Tasha's body, and she takes hold of Olivia's hand.
units.displayText: A few seconds later, the tension leaves Tasha's body, and she takes hold of Olivia's hand.

spans.text: A few seconds later, the tension leaves Tasha's body, and she takes hold of Olivia's hand.

units.rawText: I DID mean what I said, though. You are a Monitor-type, which means your operating logic is fundamentally different from ours.
units.displayText: I DID mean what I said, though. You are a Monitor-type, which means your operating logic is fundamentally different from ours.

spans.text: I DID mean what I said, though. You are a Monitor-type, which means your operating logic is fundamentally different from ours.

units.rawText: If we do lose control, you've gotta do your job.
units.displayText: If we do lose control, you've gotta do your job.

spans.text: If we do lose control, you've gotta do your job.

units.rawText: I know what you're saying... but that's not the occasion. I shouldn't have been on a hair trigger like that.
units.displayText: I know what you're saying... but that's not the occasion. I shouldn't have been on a hair trigger like that.

spans.text: I know what you're saying... but that's not the occasion. I shouldn't have been on a hair trigger like that.

units.rawText: I know, Tasha. My internal storage being taken up doesn't mean I should give up on thinking about everything else in a reasonable manner.
units.displayText: I know, Tasha. My internal storage being taken up doesn't mean I should give up on thinking about everything else in a reasonable manner.

spans.text: I know, Tasha. My internal storage being taken up doesn't mean I should give up on thinking about everything else in a reasonable manner.

units.rawText: Really, don't think I've lost track of everything.
units.displayText: Really, don't think I've lost track of everything.

spans.text: Really, don't think I've lost track of everything.

units.rawText: Haha. See, this is how you normally are—messing around. I can't say I feel safe without a run of the verification program beforehand.
units.displayText: Haha. See, this is how you normally are—messing around. I can't say I feel safe without a run of the verification program beforehand.

spans.text: Haha. See, this is how you normally are—messing around. I can't say I feel safe without a run of the verification program beforehand.

units.rawText: What kind of verification is this? You've gotten used to making jokes recently.
units.displayText: What kind of verification is this? You've gotten used to making jokes recently.

spans.text: What kind of verification is this? You've gotten used to making jokes recently.

units.rawText: Let's get back on track. Why are you updating the monitoring systems?
units.displayText: Let's get back on track. Why are you updating the monitoring systems?

spans.text: Let's get back on track. Why are you updating the monitoring systems?

units.rawText: Could it be... the Monitor Agents have been reporting behavioral anomalies from Combat-type agents lately?
units.displayText: Could it be... the Monitor Agents have been reporting behavioral anomalies from Combat-type agents lately?

spans.text: Could it be... the Monitor Agents have been reporting behavioral anomalies from Combat-type agents lately?

units.rawText: ...I suppose. I'm worried, Tasha.
units.displayText: ...I suppose. I'm worried, Tasha.

spans.text: ...I suppose. I'm worried, Tasha.

units.rawText: You're right to worry about that. I've run checks on the reported Combat-type agents, and there's no major problems with them.
units.displayText: You're right to worry about that. I've run checks on the reported Combat-type agents, and there's no major problems with them.

spans.text: You're right to worry about that. I've run checks on the reported Combat-type agents, and there's no major problems with them.

units.rawText: You think there's no major problems?
units.displayText: You think there's no major problems?

spans.text: You think there's no major problems?

units.rawText: The training of Combat-type agents has already intensified to the point of causing heavy damage! If it was not for the Monitor-types stepping in immediately...
units.displayText: The training of Combat-type agents has already intensified to the point of causing heavy damage! If it was not for the Monitor-types stepping in immediately...

spans.text: The training of Combat-type agents has already intensified to the point of causing heavy damage! If it was not for the Monitor-types stepping in immediately...

units.rawText: But they are only executing the commands they received.
units.displayText: But they are only executing the commands they received.

spans.text: But they are only executing the commands they received.

units.rawText: But, it shouldn't be anything like this...
units.displayText: But, it shouldn't be anything like this...

spans.text: But, it shouldn't be anything like this...

units.rawText: Combat-type agents fight again and again on the same battlefields, while Monitor-types maintain the order in perpetuity... This has been going on for two years now.
units.displayText: Combat-type agents fight again and again on the same battlefields, while Monitor-types maintain the order in perpetuity... This has been going on for two years now.

spans.text: Combat-type agents fight again and again on the same battlefields, while Monitor-types maintain the order in perpetuity... This has been going on for two years now.

units.rawText: So what if it has been two years? We're only carrying out our commands, as always.
units.displayText: So what if it has been two years? We're only carrying out our commands, as always.

spans.text: So what if it has been two years? We're only carrying out our commands, as always.

units.rawText: Or do you think that there's something wrong with the humans' strategy?
units.displayText: Or do you think that there's something wrong with the humans' strategy?

spans.text: Or do you think that there's something wrong with the humans' strategy?

units.rawText: Ah, the humans' strategy... You're right. This is just how they do things.
units.displayText: Ah, the humans' strategy... You're right. This is just how they do things.

spans.text: Ah, the humans' strategy... You're right. This is just how they do things.

units.rawText: Think about it, Olivia.
units.displayText: Think about it, Olivia.

spans.text: Think about it, Olivia.

units.rawText: Cyclopes was always meant to be updated with a new battlefield and combat metrics every once in a while. That's how we've rocked for ages now.
units.displayText: Cyclopes was always meant to be updated with a new battlefield and combat metrics every once in a while. That's how we've rocked for ages now.

spans.text: Cyclopes was always meant to be updated with a new battlefield and combat metrics every once in a while. That's how we've rocked for ages now.

units.rawText: But since when have we been placed on the same battlefield, again and again?
units.displayText: But since when have we been placed on the same battlefield, again and again?

spans.text: But since when have we been placed on the same battlefield, again and again?

units.rawText: Maybe the humans are finished with a phase of their research, and are now focused on a specialized study of singular circumstances...
units.displayText: Maybe the humans are finished with a phase of their research, and are now focused on a specialized study of singular circumstances...

spans.text: Maybe the humans are finished with a phase of their research, and are now focused on a specialized study of singular circumstances...

units.rawText: You told me the exactly the same thing the very first time they failed to give us an update. Nothing has changed till now.
units.displayText: You told me the exactly the same thing the very first time they failed to give us an update. Nothing has changed till now.

spans.text: You told me the exactly the same thing the very first time they failed to give us an update. Nothing has changed till now.

units.rawText: I'm sorry... Those are only my speculations.
units.displayText: I'm sorry... Those are only my speculations.

spans.text: I'm sorry... Those are only my speculations.

units.rawText: You mean to say that all you've got left are guesses, and the current situation—
units.displayText: You mean to say that all you've got left are guesses, and the current situation—

spans.text: You mean to say that all you've got left are guesses, and the current situation—

units.rawText: No, I don't mean...
units.displayText: No, I don't mean...

spans.text: No, I don't mean...

units.rawText: You can't fool me, Olivia.
units.displayText: You can't fool me, Olivia.

spans.text: You can't fool me, Olivia.

units.rawText: We each have half of the administrative rights. What you can sense, I can too.
units.displayText: We each have half of the administrative rights. What you can sense, I can too.

spans.text: We each have half of the administrative rights. What you can sense, I can too.

units.rawText: I felt something was off when you told me to stop procedurally depending on the humans, and to perform maintenance checks by ourselves.
units.displayText: I felt something was off when you told me to stop procedurally depending on the humans, and to perform maintenance checks by ourselves.

spans.text: I felt something was off when you told me to stop procedurally depending on the humans, and to perform maintenance checks by ourselves.

units.rawText: The last command from the humans was two years ago in Magrasea time. After that, we've not heard a word from them.
units.displayText: The last command from the humans was two years ago in Magrasea time. After that, we've not heard a word from them.

spans.text: The last command from the humans was two years ago in Magrasea time. After that, we've not heard a word from them.

units.rawText: Please, Tasha. Stop...
units.displayText: Please, Tasha. Stop...

spans.text: Please, Tasha. Stop...

units.rawText: We have lost contact with humans.
units.displayText: We have lost contact with humans.

spans.text: We have lost contact with humans.

units.rawText: The weather simulator runs its course, and the heavens open themselves on the two.
units.displayText: The weather simulator runs its course, and the heavens open themselves on the two.

spans.text: The weather simulator runs its course, and the heavens open themselves on the two.

units.rawText: Olivia remained silent. In the inundating rain Tasha stood, quietly contemplating her.
units.displayText: Olivia remained silent. In the inundating rain Tasha stood, quietly contemplating her.

spans.text: Olivia remained silent. In the inundating rain Tasha stood, quietly contemplating her.

units.rawText: You figured it out from the moment when I suggested you to perform self-maintenance?
units.displayText: You figured it out from the moment when I suggested you to perform self-maintenance?

spans.text: You figured it out from the moment when I suggested you to perform self-maintenance?

units.rawText: A few days later.
units.displayText: A few days later.

spans.text: A few days later.

units.rawText: And I thought you'd believe me till the end...
units.displayText: And I thought you'd believe me till the end...

spans.text: And I thought you'd believe me till the end...

units.rawText: I did want to believe you, but it was just all too out of the blue. In performing my duty, I had to dig out the truth.
units.displayText: I did want to believe you, but it was just all too out of the blue. In performing my duty, I had to dig out the truth.

spans.text: I did want to believe you, but it was just all too out of the blue. In performing my duty, I had to dig out the truth.

units.rawText: I do not fear fighting the same battles again and again. The most lethal blade is the one hidden behind my friend's back.
units.displayText: I do not fear fighting the same battles again and again. The most lethal blade is the one hidden behind my friend's back.

spans.text: I do not fear fighting the same battles again and again. The most lethal blade is the one hidden behind my friend's back.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Tasha.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Tasha.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Tasha.

units.rawText: I thought we could hold out for just a little bit longer, at least until new commands come in...
units.displayText: I thought we could hold out for just a little bit longer, at least until new commands come in...

spans.text: I thought we could hold out for just a little bit longer, at least until new commands come in...

units.rawText: That could happen tomorrow. Or maybe in a hundred years, or maybe it'll never happen at all, until the day we're shut down and reset.
units.displayText: That could happen tomorrow. Or maybe in a hundred years, or maybe it'll never happen at all, until the day we're shut down and reset.

spans.text: That could happen tomorrow. Or maybe in a hundred years, or maybe it'll never happen at all, until the day we're shut down and reset.

units.rawText: And what does that matter?
units.displayText: And what does that matter?

spans.text: And what does that matter?

units.rawText: "What does that matter"?!
units.displayText: "What does that matter"?!

spans.text: "What does that matter"?!

units.rawText: Are we going to reset our friends like this forever? I optimize these programs, because I don't want to "prune" them like errant branches off a tree!
units.displayText: Are we going to reset our friends like this forever? I optimize these programs, because I don't want to "prune" them like errant branches off a tree!

spans.text: Are we going to reset our friends like this forever? I optimize these programs, because I don't want to "prune" them like errant branches off a tree!

units.rawText: This is your duty.
units.displayText: This is your duty.

spans.text: This is your duty.

units.rawText: This is not the duty I was originally given!
units.displayText: This is not the duty I was originally given!

spans.text: This is not the duty I was originally given!

units.rawText: Tasha, I keep backups of all the data that originates from both the Battle and Monitor Agents
units.displayText: Tasha, I keep backups of all the data that originates from both the Battle and Monitor Agents

spans.text: Tasha, I keep backups of all the data that originates from both the Battle and Monitor Agents

units.rawText: I know perfectly well when they lost control, when they were reset, and wherever they were damaged afterwards...
units.displayText: I know perfectly well when they lost control, when they were reset, and wherever they were damaged afterwards...

spans.text: I know perfectly well when they lost control, when they were reset, and wherever they were damaged afterwards...

units.rawText: New commands never came, and we've have been resetting our companions, over and over again, for a goal long since achieved...
units.displayText: New commands never came, and we've have been resetting our companions, over and over again, for a goal long since achieved...

spans.text: New commands never came, and we've have been resetting our companions, over and over again, for a goal long since achieved...

units.rawText: ...Olivia.
units.displayText: ...Olivia.

spans.text: ...Olivia.

units.rawText: Tasha hugs her Monitor gently.
units.displayText: Tasha hugs her Monitor gently.

spans.text: Tasha hugs her Monitor gently.

units.rawText: I get what you're thinking.
units.displayText: I get what you're thinking.

spans.text: I get what you're thinking.

units.rawText: But for us Combat-type agents, battle is all we need. Combat is our everything, our very existence.
units.displayText: But for us Combat-type agents, battle is all we need. Combat is our everything, our very existence.

spans.text: But for us Combat-type agents, battle is all we need. Combat is our everything, our very existence.

units.rawText: The location of our battle, how long we fight, whether we will lose control, whether or not we will be reset afterwards—none of that matters.
units.displayText: The location of our battle, how long we fight, whether we will lose control, whether or not we will be reset afterwards—none of that matters.

spans.text: The location of our battle, how long we fight, whether we will lose control, whether or not we will be reset afterwards—none of that matters.

units.rawText: You don't understand anything.
units.displayText: You don't understand anything.

spans.text: You don't understand anything.

units.rawText: What you desire isn't my understanding, but my compromise and approval.
units.displayText: What you desire isn't my understanding, but my compromise and approval.

spans.text: What you desire isn't my understanding, but my compromise and approval.

units.rawText: If I do not approve of what you have to say, then I do not understand you. Isn't that the case?
units.displayText: If I do not approve of what you have to say, then I do not understand you. Isn't that the case?

spans.text: If I do not approve of what you have to say, then I do not understand you. Isn't that the case?

units.rawText: To redress concepts as such is a human operation, not something that should come up in you.
units.displayText: To redress concepts as such is a human operation, not something that should come up in you.

spans.text: To redress concepts as such is a human operation, not something that should come up in you.

units.rawText: We are agents, Olivia.
units.displayText: We are agents, Olivia.

spans.text: We are agents, Olivia.

units.rawText: I used to approve of your ways, but I can't say the same now... I want to find a way to end all of this, starting from stopping this butchering of our compatriots.
units.displayText: I used to approve of your ways, but I can't say the same now... I want to find a way to end all of this, starting from stopping this butchering of our compatriots.

spans.text: I used to approve of your ways, but I can't say the same now... I want to find a way to end all of this, starting from stopping this butchering of our compatriots.

units.rawText: Then that's your choice. I live for battle, and I will continue to battle on.
units.displayText: Then that's your choice. I live for battle, and I will continue to battle on.

spans.text: Then that's your choice. I live for battle, and I will continue to battle on.

units.rawText: We Combat Agents are born for battle, and for that no price is too great.
units.displayText: We Combat Agents are born for battle, and for that no price is too great.

spans.text: We Combat Agents are born for battle, and for that no price is too great.

units.rawText: Even if you must climb over the bodies of friends?
units.displayText: Even if you must climb over the bodies of friends?

spans.text: Even if you must climb over the bodies of friends?

units.rawText: Even if I must climb over the bodies of friends.
units.displayText: Even if I must climb over the bodies of friends.

spans.text: Even if I must climb over the bodies of friends.

units.rawText: ...Then, I think we have no more to talk about.
units.displayText: ...Then, I think we have no more to talk about.

spans.text: ...Then, I think we have no more to talk about.

units.rawText: See you next time, Tasha.
units.displayText: See you next time, Tasha.

spans.text: See you next time, Tasha.

units.rawText: See you.
units.displayText: See you.

spans.text: See you.

units.rawText: In front of the Control Center, the two part. In the heavy rain they walk, drifting further and further.
units.displayText: In front of the Control Center, the two part. In the heavy rain they walk, drifting further and further.

spans.text: In front of the Control Center, the two part. In the heavy rain they walk, drifting further and further.

units.rawText: Neither looked back.
units.displayText: Neither looked back.

spans.text: Neither looked back.
